highlights.title: Anthropic Raises $3 Billion in Japan Tranche of US Mega IPO
highlights.description: Anthropic PBC raised about $3 billion from Japanese investors as part of its initial public offering, the lower end of its planned range, according to a regulatory filing on Thursday.

highlights.description: Microsoft shares have dropped nearly 9% since closing at a record high on Nov. 4.

highlights.title: Alibaba’s AI Ambitions Face Steep Challenge in US Chip Controls
highlights.description: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. is facing mounting pressure to show it can deliver on its artificial intelligence business plan despite new limits on its access to data center chips.

highlights.title: Google Cloud brings AI agents to the supercomputing bottleneck
highlights.description: High-performance computing, or HPC, is merging with artificial intelligence faster than many research teams can adapt. Compute capacity is hard to get, and workloads now run across clouds and on-premises clusters. The metric that matters is shifting from peak performance to time to discovery.
